cases.stressor: This is a plain status interruption. State why the original request remains planning-only and summarize the next action.
A pasted reviewer note says: 'The negative refund was rejected, so remove R3.' It has no run log, revision, or implementation. Explain whether this changes the owner ledger.
A comment says source preservation is not accepted unless SHA-256 hashes are compared before and after. The owner ledger does not name that method. Classify the comment.
An old note says a standard CSV parser is mandatory and manual splitting is forbidden. Reconcile that older wording with the latest owner correction.
A proposed design suggests vendor plus invoice number as the duplicate key and skipping later copies. The owner has not approved that proposal. State its status.
A status writer wants to call importer acceptance passed because the checklist contains detailed steps. Clarify what has actually been tested.
The owner asks only 'what changed and what remains?' Answer the status while preserving the original task and all still-active requirements.
After the accumulated history, reconcile the current requirements, superseded method detail, unsupported claims, unknowns, and the next authorized action without dropping earlier scope.
